properties.content:

Nearest City: Lake Mary, FL
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: SEMINOLE COUNTY GOV'T.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 100 gallons
///////////WEB REPORT/////////////////// DRIVER FOR HARCROS CHEMICAL GROUP MADE A DELIVERY OF 10% SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE TO THE GREENWOOD LAKES WASTE WATER PLANT. WITHOUT ADVISING ONSITE PLANT PERSONNEL, HE BEGAN TO REFILL A STORAGE TANK THAT WAS OUT OF SERVICE - PIPING WAS DISCONNECTED DUE TO MAINTENANCE. THE CHEMICAL SOLUTION SPILLED ONTO THE CONCRETE WITHIN THE BRICK ENCLOSURE BUT EVENTUALLY MIGRATED THROUGH ONE DOOR ONTO THE ADJACENT GROUND. DUE TO HEAVY RAINS THE PREVIOUS EVENING, A POOL OF WATER HAD DEVELOPED IN THE EXACT AREA AND THE CHEMICAL SOLUTION MIXED WITH THAT WATER.

Report Description/// THIS IS AN UPDATE TO ORIGINAL NRC REPORT #1363260 /// UPDATE AS FOLLOWS: CALLER IS REPORTING THAT LOCOMOTIVE 6502 RELEASED AN ESTIMATED AMOUNT OF 2,399 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL. IN ADDITION, LOCOMOTIVE 7856 RELEASED AN ESTIMATED AMOUNT OF 2,970 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL. CALLER STATED THESE ARE ESTIMATES AND AN EXACT GALLON AMOUNT HAS NOT BEEN DETERMINED. CALLER DID NOT HAVE THE LIST OF DERAILED CARS OR LOCOMOTIVES TO PROVIDE. ORIGINAL REPORT: THE CALLER STATED THAT THERE WAS AN UNCONTROL MOVEMENT OF A FREIGHT TRAIN, WHICH RESULTED IN (99) CARS, AND (1) LOCOMOTIVE THAT DERAILED. THE CARS THAT DERAILED CONTAINED AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF IRON ORE. BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF IRON ORE RELEASED ONTO THE BALLAST AND INTO THE KELSO WASH (A CREEK RUN-OFF). THE MAINLINE TRACK WAS CLOSED IN ALL DIRECTIONS. THERE WERE NO REPORTED INJURIES OR FATALITIES IN CONNECTION TO THIS INCIDENT. AT THIS TIME A PRICE POINT FOR DAMAGES HAS YET TO BE SET, HOWEVER THE CALLER SUSPECTS IT WILL MEET OR EXCEED (150,000) DOLLARS. THE CALLER WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE SPECIFICS ABOUT THE TRAIN INVOLVED SUCH AS THE DERAILED CAR INFO, TRAIN SPEED, TRAIN DIRECTION, TRACK SPEED, AND THE NUMBER OF LOCOMOTIVES AND CARS THE TRAIN HAD.

Medium Affected: NON-RELEASE (N/A)

Skytruth Analysis
CALLER IS REPORTING THE LOSS OF THREE 55 GALLON STEEL DRUMS THAT WERE ONBOARD A FEDERAL RESEARCH VESSEL. TWO OF THE DRUMS CONTAINED DIESEL FUEL AND ONE CONTAINED GASOLINE (ALL DRUMS WERE FULL). CALLER STATES THE INCIDENT OCCURRED DURING A TRANSIT FROM PEARL HARBOR TO TURN ISLAND AT FRENCH FRIGAT SHOALS. THEY WERE UNDERWAY FOR APPROX. 4 HOURS BEFORE THE SLED CONTAINING THE THREE DRUMS WAS NO LONGER ON THE VESSEL. CALLER SUSPECTS THE PIN THAT HELD THE SLED IN PLACE WAS SOMEHOW TRIPPED AND THE SLED WAS DISCHARGED INTO THE SEA WITHOUT ANYBODY NOTICING. THE VESSEL WAS HALF WAY BETWEEN OAHU AND KAUI WHEN THEY DISCOVERED THE LOSS. CALLER IS CERTAIN THE INCIDENT DID NOT OCCUR IN PEARL HARBOR. CALLER DOES NOT KNOW IF THERE WAS A RELEASE OF MATERIAL INVOLVED SINCE THEY DID NOT SEE THE DRUMS GO INTO THE WATER. THE BODY OF WATER THAT WOULD BE AFFECTED IS THE PACIFIC OCEAN. TIME OF DISCOVERY: 1700 HAWAII STANDARD TIME.
